frontmatter.title: GEO Optimizer in CI/CD: GitHub Actions
frontmatter.description: Add AI-visibility audits to your CI/CD pipeline. GitHub Actions workflow to catch GEO regressions before they reach production.

frontmatter.title: Schema Injector (geo schema): JSON-LD for AI
frontmatter.description: Add JSON-LD structured data with the geo schema command: supported types, framework outputs, inline HTML injection and schema templates for AI search.

frontmatter.title: AI Crawler User-Agent List & robots.txt Rules
frontmatter.description: Complete user-agent reference for AI search and training bots in 2026, plus robots.txt allow/block rules for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Perplexity.

frontmatter.title: GEO Score Rubric & Weights (v4.18.3)
frontmatter.description: Exact GEO score weights: 8 categories, score bands and how each check contributes out of 100. Reference for the geo audit scoring in config.py.

frontmatter.title: Troubleshooting: Common GEO CLI Errors
frontmatter.description: Fix installation and runtime issues: geo command not found, Python version problems, fetch errors, sitemap failures and proxy/timing errors.

frontmatter.title: geo llms Command: Generate /llms.txt From Sitemap
frontmatter.description: Generate an /llms.txt file automatically from your XML sitemap. Full CLI reference: flags, sitemap auto-detection, sections, and the llms-full.txt companion.

frontmatter.title: GEO Optimizer — Install & First Audit
frontmatter.description: Install GEO Optimizer, the open-source Python CLI that audits and fixes your site for AI-search visibility. Run your first audit in under 5 minutes.

frontmatter.title: The 47 GEO Methods: Techniques & Tactics
frontmatter.description: Reference list of all 47 GEO methods, from Princeton KDD 2024 and AutoGEO through to RAG-readiness checks. Which category each audit flag maps to.

frontmatter.title: GEO Track Command: Scheduled AI Audits
frontmatter.description: Run recurring, tracked AI-visibility audits with geo track and keep local history. CLI reference: schedule, history, and re-audit workflows.

frontmatter.title: GEO Audit Command: Score Your Site 0–100
frontmatter.description: Run the geo audit CLI to score any website 0-100 across 8 GEO categories and get a fix list for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini citation readiness.

frontmatter.title: GEO Monitor Command: Passive Visibility Check
frontmatter.description: The geo monitor command measures a domain's AI-discoverability readiness without querying LLM APIs. Structural checks for crawling, fetching and citation.

frontmatter.title: GEO History Command: Score Trend Lookup
frontmatter.description: View the saved GEO score trend for any URL from your local tracking database. Print a timeline of audit scores and per-category deltas.
